texts.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]。地表的废墟绵延无尽，显然这颗行星曾经拥有许多庞大的城市中心。这很可能是数百万年前因内特贸易体的公民居住的地方。为什么这些坐标要被安全地存储在一个风暴庇护所里仍需调查。
texts.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Traders would have lived, eons ago. Why these coordinates were securely stored in a storm shelter will need to be investigated.

sections.en: One of the three coordinate sets found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. Given the extent of the ruins, it's clear that this planet once boasted many sprawling urban centers. This is likely where the citizens of the Inetian Traders would have lived, eons ago. Why these coordinates were securely stored in a storm shelter will need to be investigated.

texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的城市十不存一。大部分堪称地标性的大型建筑不仅受到了岁月的侵蚀，还有风暴的摧残。残存的建筑在特点上与在[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上看到的一致，也就是说，尽管有充分的证据表明存在着风暴的肆虐，但明显缺乏灾害应对准备。彻底的破坏让我们很难找到有用的东西，但希望不是完全不可能。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]在着陆点附近确定了三个兴趣点：一处是相对完整的公共服务结构，一座是类似寺庙的建筑，还有一个是巨大的中央广场。这应该是继续挖掘因内特贸易体秘密的好地方。
texts.en:
There is not much left of the cities on [From.Planet.GetName]. Besides the passage of time, most of the impressive structures that dot the landscape have been ravaged by storms. What architectural features remain are consistent with those seen on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName], namely a distinct lack of disaster response preparedness despite ample evidence for storm violence. The thorough destruction will make it difficult to find anything useful, but hopefully not impossible.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have determined three points of interest near the landing site: a relatively intact public service structure, a temple of some kind, and a massive central square. These should provide a good place to continue digging into the Inetian Traders' secrets.

texts.zh:
多个小组分头去调查这三处最有希望的地点。虽然公共服务设施和广场作为文化和建筑的典例很有意思，但只有关于信仰的地方特别值得注意。

它摇摇欲坠的外墙里隐藏着一座雄伟的大厅，里面有521个计算终端被排列成一个同心圆，在这个同心圆的中心放置着一个令人印象深刻、功能齐全的恒星系统模型。模型中灵敏的纳米组件与行星的电磁场协调一致。尽管这个模型的历史令人难以置信地悠久，但它仍然一丝不苟地反映着整个恒星系的天体运动。

此外，沿着它的圆形底座周围可以看到每一个终端位上都运行着一个交互界面。该界面的图片元素中包含了公司实体和股票价值的列表。看来这不是一个宗教崇拜的地方，而是一个因内特交易中心和证券交易所。

想必这座建筑中一定储存着重要的信息，我们应该能找到些什么。
texts.en:
Multiple teams fanned out to investigate the three most promising locations. While the service structure and public square were interesting as cultural and architectural examples, only the place of reverence was particularly noteworthy.

Its crumbling facade conceals a cavernous hall. Within, 521 computation terminals are arranged in concentric circles, at the exact center of which rests an impressive - and fully functional - model of this star system. Sensitive nano components within the model are attuned to the planet's electromagnetic fields. Despite its incredible age, the model remains an accurate representation of this system's celestial objects.

Furthermore, along its circular base runs an interface visible from every terminal position. Burned into the picture elements of this interface is a list of corporate entities and stock values. This is not a place of religious reverence, but rather an INET trading hub and stock exchange.

It is logical to conclude that this building once housed important data. It ought to be found.

texts.zh:
在更全面的调查后发现，[From.Planet.GetName]上的这个交易中心被洗劫一空了。终端全部无法操作，除了因长年显示而已经被烙印在显示屏上的图像以外没有残留下任何贸易信息。

然而，藏在大厅一角的一个存储单元里似乎藏有用户手册。利用我们在[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]挖掘过程中开发的基本翻译秘钥，我们对这些手册进行了粗略的解释。

手册里有操作终端的说明、调整系统模型的说明，以及一台被称为局部扰动抑制器的机器的帮助说明。关于如何操作、瞄准和激活这台机器的细节倒是描写得很详细。

这一定是远古庇护所里提到的那座装置，也或许就是我们要找的东西。这意味着我们又离理解因内特贸易体的意图更进一步了，也或许有希望能驾驭这台机器的力量。
texts.en:
After more thorough investigation it has become evident that the trading hub on [From.Planet.GetName] has been stripped bare. The terminals are inoperable, and besides the image burned into the model's interface, no trading information is left to be found.

However, a storage unit tucked away in one corner of the hall contained what appear to be user manuals. With the rudimentary translation keys developed during our excavation on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName], a rough interpretation of these manuals has been made.

There are instructions for operating the terminals, for tuning the system model, and for calling in assistance from a machine dubbed the Sectoral Disturbance Depressor. The details on how to operate, aim, and activate this machine are explicit.

This must be the device mentioned in the ancient storm shelter, and may be exactly what we are looking for. This means we are one step closer to understanding the intentions of the Inetian Traders, and perhaps harnessing the power of this machine for ourselves.

The manual references the machine we found on [wm_digsite_C.GetName], and how to install the part from [wm_digsite_B.GetName]. The last step is to merely activate the Sectoral Disturbance Depressor. Then we can finally harness its power for ourselves!

texts.zh:
座座工厂的上空依旧萦绕着遮天蔽日的浓厚云雾，让[From.Planet.GetName]的地表也变得难以看清。在遭受宇宙风暴的摧残之后，这颗星球的大部分地表满目疮痍，鳞次栉比的工业地景被巨大的裂隙赫然割开。

这些产出设施没有任何要被尝试拆除的迹象，只是简单地被遗弃于此，其中甚至依旧还保有生产用的原材料。对此进行分析可以让我们理解这颗行星在这个远古文明的工商业基础设施中到底扮演着什么样的角色。它也许还能告诉我们关于[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上所谓著名机械的信息。
texts.en:
It was difficult to see the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] through the thick smog still circling above its factories. Much of the planet's surface has been ravaged by cosmic storm damage, leaving large crevices in the homogenous industrial landscape. One of these presented a perfect landing opportunity for our ship.

There is no sign that any attempt was made to dismantle these production facilities. They were simply left behind, and many still contain production material. Analyzing this may allow us to understand what purpose the planet served within the ancient civilization's mercantile infrastructure. It might also tell us more about that celebrated machine referenced on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]上所使用的工业原料的初步分析发现其中含有高度爆炸性的组分。这些产品是某种更大流程的一部分，并不能单独使用。这些物质最终通过一个传送带系统运送到一个中央仓库。

从周围的烧灼痕迹来看，这个仓库很明显经常用于行星际货运。现在问题是这些产品要交付到哪里去？鉴于这些货物的爆炸性，收货地址应该不会很远。

我们在附近还发现了几个集装箱。他们显然为了能安全地打包里面的内容物花费了很多功夫，警告标签的残余物依旧还印在集装箱的侧面。标签上只能辨识出一个单词：“关键”。
texts.en:
Early analysis of the industrial materials at use on [From.Planet.GetName] indicate a highly volatile makeup. These products were part of a larger process, and not to be used on their own. The substances were eventually transported through a system of conveyors towards a centralized collection depot.

From the surrounding scorch marks, it's clear that this depot was in constant use by interplanetary transport. The question is where was the product being delivered? Given the explosive nature of the cargo it could not have been far.

Nearby we discovered several shipping crates. Pains were clearly taken to securely package the contents, as the remnants of warning labels remain printed on the sides. Only one word is still legible: "Critical."

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]很快就拆解了这个审慎封装的集装箱。

在打开第一个集装箱时发出了一阵强烈的嘶嘶声，说明其中含有一个带气候控制系统的内室。这顿时引起了一阵关于内容物会不会失稳的恐慌。幸运的是它们完好无损。

仔细检查发现里面是一个精心制作、小心安放的机器部件，里面还含有一些工厂生产的爆炸性物质。

集装箱内的运单上写着“局部扰动抑制器”。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]并不确定这到底是个什么东西，但根据这个重型集装箱和外面贴的警告来看，一定是件重要的物品。

为此，我们会把这个部件带回船上进行进一步分析。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可没必要在[From.Planet.GetName]的严酷地表上待那么长时间。
texts.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] quickly dismantled the precariously packaged crates.

Upon opening the first crate, a strong hiss denoted the presence of a climate controlled inner chamber, prompting a momentary panic that the contents might destabilize. Fortunately, they remained undamaged.

Closer inspection revealed a wonderfully crafted and carefully placed machine component, inside of which was a quantity of the volatile material produced by the factory.

A shipping label on the inside of the crate mentions something called 'Sectoral Disturbance Depressors.' Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unsure as to what this means, but given the heavy duty storage container and the warnings plastered on the outside of the crate, it must have been something important.

As such, we will bring the part aboard for further study. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] should not spend more time on the harsh surface of [From.Planet.GetName] than necessary.

The part seems to be the missing piece from the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors on [wm_digsite_C.GetName]. With the manual found on [wm_digsite_A.GetName], we will be able to properly install it and perhaps finally activate it.

As such, we will bring the part aboard for further study. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] should not spend more time on the harsh surface of [From.Planet.GetName] than necessary.

texts.zh:
无尽的狂风肆虐在[From.Planet.GetName]的表面上。如果这还不够具有挑战性，那么白雪覆盖的地面之下还藏着一个怪异的惊喜。

在地表以下，还有一层又一层厚厚的尘土在等待着我们。在其中又发现了曾生活在这颗星球上的生命形式的痕迹。他们都是在同一时间被埋葬的，说明这是一次单一的大灭绝事件。[From.Planet.GetName]生态系统的崩溃必然导致了随后的大气变薄，带入了冰河时代，最终使这颗星球变得一片荒芜。

除了沙砾和冰原，这个地方肯定还有更多的东西，但很明显，地表不会告诉我们更多秘密了。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议深入研究。
texts.en:
Endless blizzards scour the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. As if that wasn't challenging enough, the snow-covered landscape concealed a strange surprise.

Layer upon layer of dust awaited us below. Evidence of the life forms that once inhabited this world was found within. All were entombed at the same time, suggesting a singular mass extinction event. The collapse of [From.Planet.GetName]'s ecosystems must have subsequently thinned the atmosphere, bringing about an ice age that has turned the planet into a wasteland.

There must be more to this place than grit and ice sheets, but it is clear that the surface is not going to provide more answers. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] advise searching deeper.

texts.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]穿上了保护装备，乘坐重型抗寒机械，不久就完成了清除积雪和细尘这种简单重复的工作。很快，我们就发现了奇怪的特征，一系列如树根一般蜿蜒纵横的沟渠在整片土地上蔓延着。

在这些裂缝中，我们发现了各种生物的干枯遗骸，从植物到动物，以及介于之间的所有生物，所有能从地表上找到的一切应有尽有。不知何故，这些沟渠把有机质夹在岩壁之间磨碎，以提取所有有用的营养物质，并将它们运送到一个交汇点，这一过程类似于消化。它们喷出的灰尘如今覆盖了[From.Planet.GetName]的大部分地表。

这下问题就来了，这些裂缝究竟是在饲育谁，或者说什么东西呢。
texts.en:
Equipped with protective gear and frost-resistant heavy machinery, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] made short work of the tedious yet simple process of removing the snow and fine dust layers. Soon, strange patterns were discovered, a series of trenches spreading in a root-like pattern covering a vast swath of territory.

Within those crevices we found the desiccated remains of all sorts of organisms; everything it could pull from the planet's surface, from vegetation to wildlife and all that existed between. Somehow, the trenches ground up the organics by pulverizing them between their rocky walls, extracting any useful nutrients and transporting them to a convergence point in a process akin to digestion. The dust they spat back out now covers the majority of [From.Planet.GetName]'s landscapes.

This begs the question as to who, or what the crevices were feeding.

texts.zh:
地下的沟渠仿佛无边无际。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]越是深入，这些沟槽就越是密集。它们都汇聚到了[From.Planet.GetName]上仅存的一座山上。在这座山的顶上是一片不自然的高原，有三台大型的机器互相等间距地放置着。这些装置看起来应该是因内特人建造的，上面不仅写着他们的语言，而且与我们所了解的他们社会的设计相一致。相较于它们古老的历史和吹拂着高原的极端强风，这些机器看起来状况极为良好。这些应该就是[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上面所提到的机器。很遗憾的是，我们缺乏可以理解这些装置内部复杂的工作机制所需的知识。不仅如此，在其中一台机器的基部所发现的控制台显然也缺失了关键的部件。在一块小小的牌匾上雕刻着一行小字“局部扰动抑制器”。

如果我们能够激活这些机器，就能够发现它们的用途。为此，我们需要探索剩下的坐标。

无论如何，我们都找到了想要的东西。我们离重大发现仅有一步之遥了。
texts.en:
The network of underground trenches is vast. The further our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] went, the more concentrated these troughs became. They all converged on one of the last remaining mountains on [From.Planet.GetName]. Cresting the peak is a distinctly unnatural plateau, with three large machines placed at equal distances from one another. These appear to be Inetian in origin, marked in their language and consistent in design with what we know of their society. Despite their remarkable age and the extreme winds that whip the plateau, they remain in excellent condition. They must be the machines mentioned on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]. Unfortunately, we lack the knowledge required to understand the complex inner workings of these devices. Not only that, but the control console discovered at the base of one of the machines is clearly missing vital components. Engraved on a small plaque are the words "Sectoral Disturbance Depressors."

If we can activate the machines we may finally uncover their purpose. To do so we will need to explore the remaining coordinates. 

Regardless, we have found what we were looking for. We stand at the precipice of an incredible discovery.

texts.zh:
地下的沟渠仿佛无边无际。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]越是深入，这些沟槽就越是密集。它们都汇聚到了[From.Planet.GetName]上仅存的一座山上。在这座山的顶上是一片不自然的高原，有三台大型的机器互相等间距地放置着。这些装置看起来应该是因内特人建造的，上面不仅写着他们的语言，而且与我们所了解的他们社会的设计相一致。相较于它们古老的历史和吹拂着高原的极端强风，这些机器看起来状况极为良好。

我们在[wm_digsite_A.GetName]上发现的手册的图示看起来与我们面前的这台装置一致，也就是说，这些就是所谓的局部扰动抑制器，而这也就是[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上面发现的风暴庇护所所提到的机械装置。

说明书指出，这些机器需要某个控制面板才能操作。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]在其中一台机器的基部发现了这个控制面板，但似乎缺少了关键部件。但我们还有一组坐标还未探索，也许其中就藏着解决这个困境的方法。

无论如何，我们都找到了想要的东西。我们离重大发现仅有一步之遥了。
texts.en:
The network of underground trenches is vast. The further our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] went, the more concentrated these troughs became. They all converged on one of the last remaining mountains on [From.Planet.GetName]. Cresting the peak is a distinctly unnatural plateau, with three large machines placed at equal distances from one another. These appear to be Inetian in origin, marked in their language and consistent in design with what we know of their society. Despite their remarkable age and the extreme winds that whip the plateau, they remain in excellent condition. 

The schematics we observed in the manual found on [wm_digsite_A.GetName] seem to match the instruments in front of us, which must mean that these are the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors, and that this is the machine installation mentioned in the storm shelter found on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName].

The manual indicates that these machines require a control panel to be operated. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] spotted it at the foot of one of the machines, but it seems to be missing a vital part. However, we have one set of coordinates left unexplored, which could hold the means to solve this predicament. 

Regardless, we have found what we were looking for. We stand at the precipice of an incredible discovery.

地下的沟渠仿佛无边无际。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]越是深入，这些沟槽就越是密集。它们都汇聚到了[From.Planet.GetName]上仅存的一座山上。在这座山的顶上是一片不自然的高原，有三台大型的机器互相等间距地放置着。这些装置看起来应该是因内特人建造的，上面不仅写着他们的语言，而且与我们所了解的他们社会的设计相一致。相较于它们古老的历史和吹拂着高原的极端强风，这些机器看起来状况极为良好。

这一定就是[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上所提到的那台被称为局部扰动抑制器的机器！不仅如此，我们在[wm_digsite_B.GetName]找到的机械部件也可以轻易地装入其中一台机器基部的控制面板。

然而，这个部件非常复杂且历史悠久，盲目尝试进一步修理是很危险的。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议在继续推进之前搜寻更多的信息。

无论如何，我们都找到了想要的东西。我们离重大发现仅有一步之遥了。
texts.en:
The network of underground trenches is vast. The further our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] went, the more concentrated these troughs became. They all converged on one of the last remaining mountains on [From.Planet.GetName]. Cresting the peak is a distinctly unnatural plateau, with three large machines placed at equal distances from one another. These appear to be Inetian in origin, marked in their language and consistent in design with what we know of their society. Despite their remarkable age and the extreme winds that whip the plateau, they remain in excellent condition. 

These must be the machines mentioned on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName], dubbed the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors! What's more, the machine part we found on [wm_digsite_B.GetName] was easily slotted into a control panel at the foot of one of the machines.

However, any attempt at further repairs is risky given the complexity and age of the component parts. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] recommend searching for more information before proceeding. 

Regardless, we have found what we were looking for. We stand at the precipice of an incredible discovery.

地下的沟渠仿佛无边无际。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]越是深入，这些沟槽就越是密集。它们都汇聚到了[From.Planet.GetName]上仅存的一座山上。在这座山的顶上是一片不自然的高原，有三台大型的机器互相等间距地放置着。这些装置看起来应该是因内特人建造的，上面不仅写着他们的语言，而且与我们所了解的他们社会的设计相一致。相较于它们古老的历史和吹拂着高原的极端强风，这些机器看起来状况极为良好。

这些毫无疑问就是[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上所提到的机器了，同时也是[wm_digsite_A.GetName]上的手册所阐述的对象，如今我们也知道它被称为局部扰动抑制器。我们现在需要做的就是将[wm_digsite_B.GetName]上找到的部件装上去，并且希望这台机器仍然能够运转。只有那样我们才能最终发现其用途。

无论如何，我们都找到了想要的东西。我们离重大发现仅有一步之遥了。
texts.en:
The network of underground trenches is vast. The further our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] went, the more concentrated these troughs became. They all converged on one of the last remaining mountains on [From.Planet.GetName]. Cresting the peak is a distinctly unnatural plateau, with three large machines placed at equal distances from one another. These appear to be Inetian in origin, marked in their language and consistent in design with what we know of their society. Despite their remarkable age and the extreme winds that whip the plateau, they remain in excellent condition. 

These are without a doubt the machines mentioned on [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName], as well as the subjects of the manual from [wm_digsite_A.GetName], now known as the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors. All that is left to do is install the part we found on [wm_digsite_B.GetName] and hope the machines are still operational. Only then will we finally uncover their purpose. 

Regardless, we have found what we were looking for. We stand at the precipice of an incredible discovery.

label.zh: 是时候看看这台机器到底是做什么用的了。
label.en: Time to see what the machines can do.

texts.zh:
最后一块拼图终于找到了，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]开始忙碌了起来。[wm_digsite_B.GetName]上的部件严丝合缝地插入了一块控制面板。[wm_digsite_A.GetName]上的手册引导我们进行正确的安装。刚一装好，三台机器霎时间活动了起来。

雷鸣般的震响振落了高原上的尘与雪，又在一声闪电般的爆鸣中一位[Root.Owner.GetScientist]瞬间蒸发了，那具躯体化作的尘埃旋涡迅速被吸进那一道道通向行业干扰抑制器的沟渠中。

这就是[wm_digsite_C.GetName]上发生的事情的关键所在：通往机器底部的沟槽是燃料管道，会吸收周围的生物质。其结果就是在整颗星球上留下毁灭的痕迹。

局部扰动抑制器现已全面激活，剩下的燃料还够一次性使用。我们需要做的就是按下按钮。
texts.en:
The last piece of the puzzle found, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] got to work. The component from [wm_digsite_B.GetName] slotted neatly into a control console. The manual from [wm_digsite_A.GetName] was employed to install it correctly. Once this was done, all three machines burst into life.

Thunderous vibrations shook the dust and snow from the plateau. With a crackle like that of lightning a [Root.Owner.GetScientist] was instantly vaporized, the swirl of dust that was once a body quickly sucked into the trenches towards the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors.

Herein lies the key to what happened on [wm_digsite_C.GetName]: the trenches leading to the bottom of the machines are fuel lines, drawing in the bio-matter of their surroundings. The result is a trail of destruction across the planet.

The Sectoral Disturbance Depressors are now fully operational. There is enough fuel left for a single use. All that remains is the push of a button.

texts.zh:
在揭示了局部扰动抑制器的秘密之后，关于因内特贸易体的线索似乎就中断了。然而，对数据的彻底重新评估又提供了一些新的见解。

[wm_digsite_A.GetName]上的贸易记录表明，这些人保有高度的平等主义信仰。这个结论的依据是他们拥有很高的生活标准以及行星上留存的大量奢侈品工厂；每位公民，无论其职业、社会地位或血统如何，都享有平等的舒适和机会。

在[wm_digsite_B.GetName]上，我们发现了详细描述每个工厂用例的索引。这些都是更大的生产链的一部分，用于为这个庞大的帝国提供必要的手段来维持其富裕的生活方式。要公平地分配这些利益，就必须以惊人的速度消耗大量的材料和食物。

[wm_digsite_C.GetName]上修复好的行业干扰抑制器在完全报废之前又提供了更多的洞见。虽然其功能的确切目的仍然是一个谜，但至少我们寻回了一个可追踪的数据信号；这些机器的目标不是一个自由运动的实体。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]建议在附近的区域寻找与这个信号相匹配的反应。
texts.en:
After uncovering the secrets of the Sectoral Disturbance Suppressors, the trail about the Inetian Traders' fate went cold. However, a thorough reassessment of the data provided some new insights.

Trading records from [wm_digsite_A.GetName] demonstrate that these people held strong egalitarian beliefs. This conclusion is backed by the high standard of living and plentiful luxury facilities still left on the planet; with a small degree of variance, every citizen enjoyed an equal share of comfort and opportunity, no matter their profession, social standing, or lineage.

On [wm_digsite_B.GetName], we found indexes detailing the use case of each factory. These were all part of much larger production chains, set up to provide the vast empire with the necessary means to support its opulent lifestyle. Equal distribution of these benefits necessitated a truly staggering amount of material and food consumption, produced at breakneck speeds.

[wm_digsite_C.GetName]'s repaired Sectoral Disturbance Depressors provided some more insights before being fully decommissioned. While the exact purpose of their function is still a mystery, a traceable data signal was recovered; the machines were not aimed at a freely moving entity.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] recommend searching nearby sectors for a matching response to this signal.

texts.zh: 在远古风暴庇护所中发现的三个坐标之一将我带到了[From.Planet.GetName]，这是因内特贸易体的一颗工业星球。从其上现存的建筑来看，这颗行星显然不是用来居住的。然而，我们仍不能确定其上的工厂究竟是用于生产什么的。
texts.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName], an industrial world from the Inetian Traders' empire. Based on the existing architecture, this was clearly not a residential planet. However, it remains uncertain what exactly its industrial might was meant to produce.

texts.en: One of the three coordinates found in the ancient storm shelter has led us to [From.Planet.GetName]. The surface is little more than snow and dust, but initial scans show that the planet was once habitable. Was it important to the Inetian Traders before or after its ruin?

texts.zh: [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]上的三个坐标拼起了一幅古老的拼图，剩下的事就是激活局部扰动抑制器了。终于到了搞明白它的用途的时候了。
texts.en: The three coordinates from [wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName] completed an ancient puzzle. All that is left is to activate the Sectoral Disturbance Depressors. The time has come to discover their purpose.
